channel.title: San Diego Community Newsgroup - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from San Diego Community Newsgroup (sdnews.com)

item.title: Trump targeted these universities, but Congress is still helping them out
item.description: After the Trump administration blocked federal money for some universities, GOP lawmakers helped steer millions in spending for projects in 2026.

item.title: Dance Marathon at SDSU moves students for life-saving care
item.description: The event is part of a year-long fundraising movement focused on helping others, and it is one of more than 400 such programs nationwide.

item.title: Opinion: Preventing human trafficking requires reproductive justice in California
item.description: Effective prevention requires more than awareness. It requires addressing one of the most overlooked tools of exploitation: reproductive control.

item.title: Point Loma Nazarene updates policies on federal immigration enforcement
item.description: Point Loma Nazarene has updated its campus policies regarding immigration enforcement in response to California’s SB 98.

item.title: San Diego Mesa and Southwestern colleges can offer new bachelor’s degrees, despite CSU objections
item.description: San Diego Mesa College will offer a degree as a physical therapy assistant, and Southwestern College will give degrees in transborder environmental design.

item.title: Peninsula Beacon: Feb. 20, 2026
item.description: Inside this edition of the Peninsula Beacon: Arts District Liberty Station celebrates its 25th anniversary and earns California Cultural District status. Point Loma spring sports preview, new “Heroes” art exhibit, and a novel that “solves” the 1964 Ocean Beach murders.

item.title: Three shows and two musical parties to attend this week
item.description: Whether your tastes run to film synth-y indie, classic reggae, or raunchy rap, you'll find something to satisfy your audio appetite.

item.title: Drunk driver sentenced to 8 years in prison for fatal Lemon Grove crash
item.description: James Mendias, 29, pleaded guilty to gross vehicular manslaughter while intoxicated for the crash that killed Tonia Silva, 36.

item.title: Millions in federal funding awarded for long-delayed San Luis Rey River project
item.description: Seven projects will share $32 million in federal funding secured by California's two senators. The largest share will go to the Oceanside project.

item.title: Senator, county officials blast ICE for barring them from detention facility
item.description: A confrontation between immigration authorities and San Diego County supervisors sets up a potential court challenge testing one of California's many efforts to rein in the Trump administration's aggressive raids and deportations.
